en.description: A tiled portal and a five-sided courtyard ringed by student cells, a few minutes' walk from Chorsu bazaar.

en.history: The madrasa was built in 1910-1912 with funds of Mulla Qirg'iz Mashrabboy. Its portal is faced with blue, green, yellow and white glazed tiles, and the plan follows the irregular plot as a pentagon.
facts: The plan is an irregular pentagon surrounded by hujras.
Closed in the 1930s, restored after independence.
The nearby Ota Valixon to'ra mosque is attributed to the same builder.

en.name: Akhsikent (Akhsikath) archaeological site
en.tagline: Ancient capital of Fergana on the Syr Darya
en.description: Ruins of a 30-ha fortified city on the Syr Darya with an open-air museum and excavation areas, about 22 km south-west of Namangan.
en.address: Right bank of the Syr Darya, Turakurgan district
en.hoursNote: Open Monday to Friday; about one hour from Namangan.
en.feeNote: A 2026 guide lists entry as free; a 2019 report gave 2,000 so'm. Check on site.
en.history: Known from the 3rd century BC and flourishing in the 9th-12th centuries. Babur's father Umar Shaikh Mirza ruled from here and died at the fortress in 1494. After the 1620 earthquake its people moved to Namangan.
facts: Its crucible steel was known as far as Baghdad and Damascus.
Sacked in 1219 by Jebe, a commander of Genghis Khan.
By October 2025 entrance gates, towers and an open-air museum at the defensive wall were completed.

ru.history: Известен с III века до н.э., расцвет в IX-XII веках. Отец Бабура Умаршейх Мирза правил отсюда и погиб в крепости в 1494 году. После землетрясения 1620 года жители переселились в Наманган.
facts: Местная тигельная сталь была известна вплоть до Багдада и Дамаска.
Разорён в 1219 году Джебе, полководцем Чингисхана.
К октябрю 2025 года завершены входные ворота, башни и музей под открытым небом у крепостной стены.

en.name: Ancient Pap (Balandtepa) and Munchoqtepa
en.description: Ruins of ancient Pap on the Syr Darya and the Munchoqtepa necropolis of underground crypts. During digs, approach only with the archaeologists' permission.
en.hoursNote: Open site without a ticket desk or fixed hours.
en.history: Ancient Pap was a Silk Road town of the 1st-8th centuries, on the UNESCO tentative list since 2008. The Munchoqtepa necropolis was found by chance in the 1980s and is known for reed coffins and silk.
facts: In 2024 a Uzbek-Chinese team found six new tombs, the largest with at least 24 burials.
Silk fragments date to the 5th century at the latest, mostly imported from China.

ru.history: Древний Пап был городом на Шёлковом пути в I-VIII веках, с 2008 года в предварительном списке ЮНЕСКО. Некрополь Мунчактепа найден случайно в 1980-х и известен тростниковыми гробами и шёлком.
facts: В 2024 году узбекско-китайская экспедиция нашла шесть новых гробниц, в самой большой не менее 24 погребений.
Фрагменты шёлка датируются не позднее V века, в основном привезены из Китая.

uz.hoursNote: Rasmiy ish vaqti e'lon qilinmagan; ertalab eng faol. Pichoqni samolyotda faqat topshiriladigan yukda olib ketish mumkin.
uz.feeNote: Narxlar kelishiladi; pichoqni ustadan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olish mumkin.
uz.history: Chust Farg'ona vodiysining eng qadimiy shaharlaridan, bu yerda Chust madaniyati aniqlangan. Pichoqchilik avloddan avlodga o'tadi, har bir usta tig'ga o'z tamg'asini bosadi.
facts: Yiliga taxminan yarim million esdalik pichoq ishlab chiqariladi.
Chust do'ppisida qalampir naqshi to'rt marta takrorlanadi.
Haftada bir marta do'ppi bozori o'tadi.

en.name: Chust Bazaar and knife makers
en.tagline: Home of the Chust knife and skullcap
en.description: The farmers' market sells maker-stamped Chust knives, black skullcaps with white embroidery, robes and copperware; forges sit in the Suzangarlar quarter.
en.hoursNote: No official hours published; busiest in the morning. Knives can fly only in checked baggage.
en.feeNote: Prices are negotiated; knives can be bought straight from the makers.
en.history: Chust is one of the oldest towns of the Fergana Valley, where the Chust culture was identified. Knife-making passes down generations and every smith stamps his mark on the blade.
facts: About half a million souvenir knives are made a year.
The pepper motif appears four times on a Chust doppi.
A skullcap market is held once a week.

ru.name: Чустский базар и мастера ножей
ru.description: На дехканском базаре продают чустские ножи с клеймом мастера, чёрные тюбетейки с белой вышивкой, чапаны и медную посуду; кузницы в квартале Сузангарлар.
ru.hoursNote: Официальные часы не опубликованы, активнее всего утром. Ножи в самолёте только в багаже.
ru.feeNote: Цены договорные, ножи можно купить прямо у мастеров.
ru.history: Чуст один из древнейших городов Ферганской долины, здесь выделена чустская культура. Ремесло ножовщиков передаётся из поколения в поколение, каждый мастер ставит клеймо на клинок.
facts: В год делают около полумиллиона сувенирных ножей.
Узор «калампир» на чустской тюбетейке повторяется четыре раза.
Раз в неделю проходит рынок тюбетеек.

en.name: Chodak village
en.description: A village in the Chodaksoy gorge with suspension bridges, a 50 m glass bridge, ziplines, waterfalls, the Chir-chir momo spring and guesthouses.
en.history: Chodak received tourist village status in September 2024. It has about 300 family guesthouses, four 300 m suspension bridges and a 400 m cable route.

There is a cave more than 42 m deep nearby.

en.name: Nanay village
en.tagline: First tourism village in the Fergana Valley
en.description: A mountain village on the Podshootasoy stream with a suspension bridge, zipline, a 1.3 km health trail, artificial waterfalls and over 150 guesthouses.
en.history: On 31 August 2024 Nanay became the first village in the Fergana Valley with tourism village status. In the first eight months of 2024 it had about 20,000 foreign and over 220,000 domestic visitors.
facts: The village sits on the Kyrgyz border, 40 km from Namangan.
Seven artificial waterfalls were built on the stream.

uz.description: Maqbara, zamonaviy masjid, ramziy darvoza, muzey va baliqli hovuzdan iborat majmua. Yaqinida onasi Bibi Naima ona qadamjoyi bor.
uz.bestTime: Ish kunlari ertalab, juma va bayramlardan tashqari

Hovuz endemik baliqlari bilan mashhur.

en.name: Sultan Uvays Karani Shrine (Baliqlikul)
en.tagline: Mountain shrine and mosque in Chortoq district
en.description: A complex with a tomb, a modern mosque, a symbolic gate, a museum and a fish pond, with the shrine of his mother Bibi Naima nearby.
en.bestTime: Weekday mornings, avoiding Fridays and holidays
en.hoursNote: No official hours published; usually open in daytime.
en.feeNote: Free entry; there is a donation box.
en.history: The shrine has operated as a pilgrimage site since 2001. After a 2017 reconstruction project the tomb was fully rebuilt, 6 ha were landscaped and over 1,500 trees planted.
facts: The complex has a library, guest rooms and a conference hall.
The pond is known for its endemic fish.

ru.tagline: Горная святыня и мечеть в Чартакском районе

facts: В комплексе библиотека, гостиница и конференц-зал.

en.name: Kosonsoy Friday Mosque
en.description: A walled-courtyard Friday mosque with a domed portal, a three-niche mihrab and white-and-blue decoration.
en.hoursNote: No official hours published; the mosque opens around prayer times.
en.feeNote: Free entry; there is a donation box.
en.history: Regarded as an 18th-century monument, though tradition says building began in the 17th century. In Soviet times it was a warehouse and then a school; it reopened as a mosque in 1991 and was named in 1992 after A'lokhon Makhdum, buried nearby.
facts: The prayer hall measures 28.6 by 10.8 m.
An iwan and classrooms were added in 1993.

facts: Размер зала 28,6 на 10,8 м.
В 1993 году пристроены айван и классы.

en.name: Ishoqxon Ibrat Memorial Complex and Museum
en.tagline: Museum of the enlightener and publisher
en.description: Museum, garden, avenue and statue in Turakurgan on Ibrat's life, books and the printing press he set up in 1908.
en.hoursNote: Opening hours are not published online; call before you go.
en.history: Ishoqxon Tora Ibrat, born in Turakurgan in 1862, was a poet, linguist and historian. In 1908 he bought a lithographic press in Orenburg and opened the Ishoqiya printing house in his yard. He was arrested in 1937 and died in prison.
facts: He compiled a six-language dictionary.
Author of the History of Fergana.
The complex was started in 2017 on the President's initiative.

ru.name: Мемориальный комплекс Исхакхана Ибрата

ru.history: Исхакхан Тура Ибрат родился в Туракургане в 1862 году, поэт, языковед и историк. В 1908 году купил литографский станок в Оренбурге и открыл во дворе типографию «Исхакия». В 1937 году арестован и умер в тюрьме.
facts: Составил словарь на шести языках.
Автор «Истории Ферганы».
Комплекс начали создавать в 2017 году по инициативе Президента.

uz.history: Nodim Namangoniy (asl ismi Sulaymonxo'ja Ulug'xo'ja o'g'li, 1844-1910) Namanganda tug'ilib, shu yerda vafot etgan shoir. U turkiy va forsiy tilda g'azallar, hajviy she'rlar yozgan.

en.description: A small mausoleum with a green dome on Nodira street, near the regional museum, set in a landscaped square.
en.bestTime: Daytime, together with the regional museum
en.history: Nodim Namangani (born Sulaymonkhoja, son of Ulugkhoja, 1844-1910) was a poet born and buried in Namangan. He wrote ghazals in Turkic and Persian and satirical verse.
facts: A full copy of his anthology Bayozi Nodim is kept at the Institute of Oriental Studies.
His poems appeared in the Turkistan provincial newspaper.

facts: Полный список его сборника «Баёзи Нодим» хранится в Институте востоковедения.
Его стихи печатались в «Туркестанской туземной газете».

uz.name: Mavlono Lutfulloh majmuasi (Chust)
uz.description: Chust shahar markazidagi bog' ichida masjid, ramziy qabr, minora va muzey. Bog'dagi buloqlar avliyo nomi bilan bog'lanadi.
uz.address: Chust shahri, madaniyat va istirohat bog'i
uz.history: Mavlono Lutfulloh 1487-yilda Pop tumanining Chodak qishlog'ida tug'ilgan, Farg'ona vodiysida Naqshbandiya tariqatining yirik vakili bo'lgan. Majmua bir paytlar madrasa, masjid, maqbara, uy va minoradan iborat edi; asl qabr joyi aniq emas, bog'dagi qabr ramziy.
facts: Saqlanib qolgan minora XIX asr oxirida usta Mulla Qirg'iz va shogirdlari tomonidan ta'mirlangan, balandligi 17 m.
Masjid ayvonidagi naqshlar 1971-1972 yillarda Namangan ustalari tomonidan tiklangan.
Majmuada Chust tarixini bronza davridan ko'rsatuvchi muzey bor.

en.name: Mavlono Lutfulloh Complex, Chust
en.tagline: A 17 m minaret and a spring-fed park
en.description: A mosque, a symbolic tomb, a minaret and a museum inside the central park of Chust; the park's springs are linked to the saint in local legend.
en.address: Chust city culture and recreation park
en.history: Mavlono Lutfulloh was born in 1487 in Chodak village, Pop district, and became a leading Naqshbandi figure in the Fergana valley. The complex once had a madrasa, mosque, mausoleum, house and minaret; his real grave is lost and the tomb in the park is symbolic.
facts: The surviving minaret was repaired at the end of the 19th century by master Mulla Qirg'iz and his students; it is 17 m tall.
The painted decoration of the mosque porch was restored by Namangan painters in 1971-1972.
A museum in the complex shows Chust history from the Bronze Age.

ru.name: Комплекс Мавлоно Лутфуллы (Чуст)
ru.description: Мечеть, символическая гробница, минарет и музей в центральном парке Чуста; родники парка предание связывает с именем святого.
ru.address: Город Чуст, парк культуры и отдыха
ru.history: Мавлоно Лутфулла родился в 1487 году в кишлаке Чодак Папского района и стал видным деятелем ордена Накшбандия в Ферганской долине. Комплекс включал медресе, мечеть, мавзолей, дом и минарет; настоящая могила утрачена, гробница в парке символическая.
facts: Сохранившийся минарет отремонтирован в конце XIX века мастером Мулла Киргизом с учениками, высота 17 м.
Росписи айвана мечети восстановлены наманганскими мастерами в 1971-1972 годах.
В комплексе есть музей истории Чуста с эпохи бронзы.

en.name: Gova village
en.tagline: Mountain village on a cold river, summer escape
en.description: A mountain village in the north of Chust district on the Kyrgyz border. A stream runs through it and valley residents come in summer for the cool air; cottages and guest rooms are available. The glacier river is very cold and fast: do not swim in it or drink from it.
en.history: Gova is a mountain village in northern Chust district, about 60 km from Namangan. Residents live from farming, orchards, livestock and beekeeping.
facts: Reached by shared taxi from Chust.
It received town status in 2009.
Also known for potato growing.

В 2009 году получил статус посёлка.
Известен также выращиванием картофеля.
